text:
aina: quick thought — instead of landing a broad runtime shim that translates every old client shape, can we do a narrow ingress shim at the gateway level that only handles header translation + envelope unwrapping? lower blast radius and easier to retire.

sam: +1 to smaller scope. main question: will that hide mismatch bugs from internal services that expect the new shape? :thinking:

maria: telemetry can catch that. if the ingress shim emits a migration_trace header and increments a metric per-mapped-field, we can build alerting for fields that frequently map -> null or get dropped.

aina: exactly. propose lifecycle: 1) opt-in header sniffing mode (clients add X-RW-Compat: opt-in) 2) ingress shim active for opt-ins only 3) promote to opt-out cohort after 30d of no errors 4) retire shim after 90d of opt-out. keeps us from supporting forever.

tom: operational concerns: memory/CPU on the gateway for per-request parsing. keep the shim as a tiny transform function (no JSON.parse on whole body when not needed). maybe only touch when header present. also add a circuit-breaker if mapping latency > 20ms for 3s window.

aina: yes — implementation sketch: pseudoconfig below. it only runs when X-RW-Compat: 1 or when tenant has feature-flag

```
# gateway/compat-mapping.yaml
mappings:
  - name: legacy-envelopes
    when_header: X-RW-Compat
    translate:
      headers:
        - from: Legacy-Client-Version
          to: X-Client-Version
      body:
        envelope.unwrap: true
    timeout_ms: 15
    circuit_breaker: {failure_window_ms:3000, max_latency_ms:20}
```

maria: with that config we can tag spans and add a shim_usage_count tag on traces. I also want a histogram for mapped_field_errors so we can pick a safe promote time.

jen: doc + comms note: we should publish a short migration playbook for customers (how to add header, how to opt-out, expected deadlines). marketing/CS will need a template for the deprecation email. i can draft if you give me the timelines.

sam: one more tradeoff: some older SDKs don't let customers set custom headers easily. we should provide a client adapter snippet in each SDK repo (2-liner) so it's trivial. also consider a slow-roll cohort by customer size.

deploy-bot: canary deployed ingress-shim v0.1 to prod-us-2 (traffic: 1%). logs -> /infra/ingress-shim/2026-03-23/

aina: thanks — action items: sam to prepare SDK adapter snippets, maria to add telemetry metrics and alert rules, tom to add circuit-breaker + perf budget, jen to draft comms + playbook. we'll reconvene in 1 week for metrics check. :+1:
